title: PRECIOUS LORD, TAKE MY HAND
author: Thomas Dorsey
stanzas: Precious Lord, take my hand, Lead me on, let me stand, I am tired, I am weak, I am worn; Through the storm, Lead me on to the light:
When the darkness appears, And the night draws near, And the day is past and gone, At the river I stand, Guide my feet hold my hand
chorus: Take my hand, precious Lord, Lead me home When my way grow drear, precious Lord, linger near, when my life is almost gone, Hear my cry, hear my call, Hold my hand lest I fall;
